title: A FEAST FOR TROLLS: ENGAGEMENT ANALYSIS OF COUNTERNARRATIVES AGAINST ONLINE TOXICITY
reasoning: The paper focuses on analyzing engagement with AI-supported counternarratives against online toxicity (racism, sexism, etc.). While it identifies Islamophobia as a category of toxicity and discusses the ethical implications of 'black box' AI models, it does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical frameworks as a central research component.
